airspace.zh: 瓜地馬拉由民航局（DGAC）管理：飛行須取得DGAC授權並登記，一般限高400呎、目視飛行、不得夜飛；機場3海里內與限制區須另行許可。實際飛行前請向DGAC申請。
airspace.en: Guatemala's civil aviation authority (DGAC) requires authorization and registration; flights are generally limited to 400 ft, within sight and not at night, with separate permission within 3 NM of aerodromes and in restricted areas. Apply to the DGAC before flying.

tikal.note: site coordinates (Wikipedia), by the Great Plaza

temple1.zh: 一號神廟（大美洲豹神廟）
temple1.en: Temple I (Temple of the Great Jaguar)
temple1.note: east side of the Great Plaza, c. 732

mundo.note: E-Group astronomical complex founded c. 700 BC

uaxactun.note: airstrip of Uaxactun village, 19 km north of Tikal

title.en: The Rise and Fall of Mutul

tagline.zh-Hant: 從前四世紀的聚落到九世紀的最後一座石碑
tagline.en: From a settlement of the fourth century BCE to the last stela in 869

zh: 瓜地馬拉北部佩滕的雨林裡，
神廟的屋頂冠探出樹冠。
en: In the forest of Petén, northern Guatemala,
temple roof combs rise above the canopy.

zh: 這是蒂卡爾，古典期重要的馬雅城市，
馬雅人稱它穆圖爾。
en: This is Tikal, a major Maya city of the Classic period;
the Maya called it Mutul.

zh: 北衛城最早的建築，
約在西元前三五〇年出現。
en: The first buildings of the North Acropolis
went up around 350 BCE.

zh: 城市在西元三〇〇到八五〇年間最興盛。
en: The city flourished between AD 300 and 850.

zh: 西元378年1月14日，國王查克托克伊恰克死去，
外來的西亞赫卡克同一天抵達。
en: On 14 January 378 King Chak Tok Ich'aak died;
Siyaj K'ak' arrived the same day.

zh: 學者認為，這可能是一次來自特奧蒂瓦坎的入侵。
en: Scholars suggest it may have been an invasion from Teotihuacan.

zh: 562年，蒂卡爾被卡拉克穆爾與卡拉科爾擊敗。
en: In 562 Tikal was defeated by Calakmul and Caracol.

zh: 682年即位的哈索・產・卡威爾，
695年擊敗卡拉克穆爾，重建城市。
en: Jasaw Chan K'awiil, king from 682,
defeated Calakmul in 695 and rebuilt the city.

zh: 他葬在一號神廟下，
神廟約在732年建成。
en: He was buried beneath Temple I,
built around 732.

zh: 往西是四號神廟，
約741年為下一任國王建造。
en: To the west is Temple IV,
built around 741 for the next king.

zh: 神廟的木楣雕著國王坐轎的場面，
紀念743年的一場勝利。
en: A carved wooden lintel shows the king on a litter,
marking a victory in 743.

zh: 869年，十一號石碑豎立，
是蒂卡爾最後一座有紀年的紀念碑。
en: In 869 Stela 11 was set up,
the last dated monument at Tikal.

zh: 到了九〇〇年前後，城市已被放棄；
1848年，佩滕的官員來到廢墟。
en: By about 900 the city had been abandoned;
in 1848 officials from Petén visited the ruins.

zh: 1955年設國家公園，1979年列入世界遺產，
雨林重新包圍了這座王城。
en: A national park from 1955 and World Heritage from 1979,
the royal city is wrapped in forest again.

title.zh-Hant: 廣場、衛城與失落的世界

tagline.zh-Hant: 王陵、宮殿、天文建築群與堤道，一座古典期馬雅城市的布局
tagline.en: Royal tombs, palaces, an astronomical complex and causeways: the plan of a Classic Maya city

zh: 大廣場東側是一號神廟，
西側是二號神廟，隔著廣場相對。
en: On the east of the Great Plaza stands Temple I,
facing Temple II across it.

zh: 一號神廟又叫大美洲豹神廟，
高約四十七公尺。
en: Temple I is also called the Temple of the Great Jaguar;
it is about 47 metres high.

zh: 廣場北邊是北衛城，
一千三百多年間一直是王室墓地。
en: North of the plaza is the North Acropolis,
a royal burial ground for more than 1,300 years.

zh: 它的基台約一百乘八十公尺，
比廣場高出十二公尺。
en: Its base platform is about 100 by 80 metres
and stands 12 metres above the plaza.

zh: 早古典期時，
基台上已立著八座神廟金字塔。
en: By the Early Classic
eight temple-pyramids stood on the platform.

zh: 不遠處的中央衛城，
有一座五層的王宮。
en: Nearby, the Central Acropolis
held a five-storey royal palace.

zh: 往西南，是「失落的世界」建築群。
en: To the south-west is the Mundo Perdido, the Lost World complex.

zh: 它約在西元前七〇〇年興建，
一直用到九〇〇年前後。
en: It was founded around 700 BC
and used until about AD 900.

zh: 它是一組「E組群」天文建築：
一座金字塔對著東邊台上的三座神廟。
en: It is an "E-Group" astronomical complex:
a pyramid facing a platform with three temples to the east.

zh: 城中各區由堤道相連，
今天以莫德斯雷、馬勒等人的名字命名。
en: Causeways joined the parts of the city;
today they bear names such as Maudslay and Maler.

zh: 蒂卡爾有三千多座建築，
分布在約十五平方公里內。
en: Tikal has more than 3,000 structures
spread over about 15 square kilometres.

zh: 人口估計從一萬到九萬人都有，
學者看法不一。
en: Estimates of its population range from 10,000 to 90,000;
scholars disagree.

zh: 北方十九公里，
是另一座馬雅城市烏夏克吞。
en: Nineteen kilometres north
is another Maya city, Uaxactun.

zh: 「E組群」這個名字，
就是從烏夏克吞的發掘而來。
en: The name "E-Group"
comes from the excavations at Uaxactun.

title.en: A Royal City in the Rainforest

tagline.zh-Hant: 五萬七千公頃的國家公園：鳥、貓科動物與熱帶森林
tagline.en: A 57,600-hectare park: birds, wild cats and tropical forest

zh: 清晨的霧從森林裡升起，
只露出神廟的頂。
en: Morning mist rises from the forest
and only the temple tops show.

zh: 蒂卡爾國家公園面積五萬七千六百公頃。
en: Tikal National Park covers 57,600 hectares.

zh: 公園裡有熱帶森林、
莽原與濕地。
en: The park holds tropical forest,
savanna and wetlands.

zh: 這裡記錄到三百多種鳥，
包括眼斑火雞和鶴鷹。
en: More than 300 bird species have been recorded here,
among them the ocellated turkey and the crane hawk.

zh: 森林裡有五種野生貓科動物，
包括美洲豹與美洲獅。
en: Five species of wild cat live in the forest,
including the jaguar and the puma.

zh: 還有幾種猴子與食蟻獸。
en: There are also several species of monkeys and anteaters.

zh: 四號神廟頂上的三根木楣，
用的是人心果木。
en: The three lintels of the Temple IV shrine
were made of sapodilla wood.

zh: 神廟頂朝東，正前方是三號神廟，
更遠是一號與二號神廟。
en: The summit faces east: Temple III directly ahead,
Temples I and II beyond.

zh: 從上方看，森林把廣場與神廟包在中間。
en: From above, the forest closes around the plazas and temples.

zh: 城市蓋在幾道平行的石灰岩山脊上，
四周是沼澤低地。
en: The city stands on parallel limestone ridges
rising above swampy lowlands.

zh: 蒂卡爾人用十座水庫，儲存雨水。
en: Tikal stored rainwater in ten reservoirs.

zh: 國家公園也是馬雅生物圈保護區的一部分。
en: The park is part of the Maya Biosphere Reserve.

zh: 1982年，國家公園擴大，
把北方的烏夏克吞也納進來。
en: In 1982 the park was enlarged
to take in Uaxactun to the north.

zh: 北方的森林，
屬於同一片馬雅生物圈保護區。
en: The forest to the north
lies within the same Maya Biosphere Reserve.

title.zh-Hant: 石灰岩山脊上的金字塔

tagline.zh-Hant: 神廟的高度、城市的範圍，與佩滕低地的地形
tagline.en: The heights of the temples, the reach of the city and the land of the Petén lowlands

zh: 蒂卡爾在佩滕低地，
石灰岩山脊之間夾著沼澤。
en: Tikal lies in the Petén lowlands,
where swamps lie between limestone ridges.

zh: 城市利用周圍約兩百平方公里的土地。
en: The city drew on about 200 square kilometres of land around it.

zh: 一號神廟高約四十七公尺。
en: Temple I rises about 47 metres.

zh: 廣場對面的二號神廟，
高約三十八公尺。
en: Temple II, across the plaza,
is about 38 metres high.

zh: 往西，三號神廟高五十五公尺。
en: Westwards, Temple III stands 55 metres high.

zh: 四號神廟從廣場地面到屋頂冠約七十公尺，
是蒂卡爾最高的建築。
en: Temple IV is about 70 metres from plaza floor to roof comb,
the tallest structure at Tikal.

zh: 它在遺址核心的西緣，
神廟頂朝東對著城市中心。
en: It stands at the western edge of the core,
its summit shrine facing east to the centre.

zh: 五號神廟高五十七公尺，
是蒂卡爾第二高的建築。
en: Temple V, 57 metres high,
is the second tallest structure at Tikal.

zh: 失落的世界的大金字塔，
是這組建築群的主體。
en: The Lost World Pyramid
dominates its complex.

zh: 城市蓋在石灰岩山脊上，
雨水存進十座水庫。
en: The city was built on limestone ridges;
rainwater was kept in ten reservoirs.

zh: 四條堤道，把各組建築連在一起。
en: Four causeways link the groups of buildings.

zh: 往西南走公路約六十四公里，是弗洛雷斯。
en: About 64 km south-west by road is Flores.

zh: 往北十九公里，是烏夏克吞。
en: Nineteen kilometres north lies Uaxactun.

zh: 石灰岩撐起神廟，
雨林蓋住其餘的一切。
en: Limestone holds up the temples;
the rainforest covers everything else.
